name: backup-management-ux-hardening
title: Harden backup management UX and scope
description: Synchronize the backup page with the canonical manager restaurant scope, invalidate stale previews when restore inputs change, expose permission-aware controls, and compact the interface without changing snapshot semantics.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Keep BackupRun, snapshot schema, import/export service behavior, permission guards, audit logging, checksums, and conflict resolution semantics unchanged. Reuse useManagerRestaurantSelection and existing frontend permission helpers.
